environment.description: FastAPI service on EC2 with security group restricting inbound to CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing, pl-3b927c52). CloudFront distribution configured with Origin Access Control (OAC) using SigV4 signing policy for custom origin. Distribution behavior requires signed URLs with RSA-2048 key pair (key group kg-0f8a2e91bc) for all paths matching /transfer* and /api/*. CloudFront cache policy set to CachingDisabled (policy 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad) with origin request policy AllViewerExceptHostHeader. Viewer protocol policy HTTPS-only. The signed URL policy restricts DateLessThan to 30 seconds from issuance and includes source IP condition matching the viewer's IP. Custom error page returns 403 for all 4xx from origin.

config.security_group: sg-9e8f7d6c: inbound 443 from pl-3b927c52 (CloudFront prefix list only)
config.origin_access_control: OAC with SigV4 signing, always sign
config.key_group: kg-0f8a2e91bc (RSA-2048, private key in Secrets Manager)
